fact: ANIP says it is in charge of the electoral file and that the electoral list is available in a few clicks.
ANIP says its USSD channel is used massively for consulting and transferring electors.
ANIP says a death recorded in the RNPP automatically removes the person from the electoral lists.
ANIP says the computerised provisional electoral list (LEIP) is displayed in all voting centres from 13 to 28 September 2025.
ANIP says voters can check their voting centre on the displayed list, by phone (15110#, option 4) or the Anipbenin.bj app using their NPI, and request corrections or transfers.
ANIP says the list is extracted directly from the Fichier National de l'État Civil, the database also used for national identity cards.
ANIP says electoral lists are generated automatically from the RNPP.
ANIP says electoral lists are generated from the RNPP, the national identification register.
